questions.q: What did the crocodile do after finding food?
questions.explain: The crocodile found food and ate it next.

questions.q: How did the crocodile feel after eating?
questions.explain: The crocodile was no longer hungry and felt happy after eating.

questions.q: What happened to the crocodile after he got hungry again?
questions.explain: The crocodile got hungry again and ate after searching for food.
